'''Resh''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] who once worked as an enforcer for [[Darga Jiramma Mionne|Darga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. After Darga's death and a failed attempt to seize control of his organization, Resh became the target of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] bounty and fled to the lower levels of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] while searching for a way off-planet. [[Sisla]] was able to track him to [[The Works/Legends|The Works]].
